verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents programmatic control through Python packages installable via pip, standalone scripts that control robots and environments, and ROS 2 services and actions that load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations. Isaac Lab adds headless operation for automated workflows. The 404s on OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown docs show only that there is no HTTP/REST spec or LLM-oriented docs; they do not contradict the SDK and ROS APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of a detailed API reference beyond overview pages, any HTTP/REST surface or machine-readable spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product programmatically.
